build.summary: KS-N8 is a theory task with no Rust change. The operator is flux-form ring-constant advection-diffusion on the spatial.rs grid, centred as the primary scheme; upwind equals centred plus an A-self-adjoint negative semidefinite diffusion. Each mode block has a real symmetric tridiagonal A-Hermitian part, so the §4.2 pivot count applied to zI-Ht_m certifies z > mu_A(J). That gives ||W(z)^-1||_A <= 1/(z-mu_A), complex Thomas pivots with Re p >= z-mu_A, ||e^{tJ}||_A <= e^{t mu_A}, and ||R(hJ)||_A <= sup over Re w <= h mu_A of |R| (von Neumann). The RODAS5P pole condition is the same as the certificate condition. For zonal (divergence-free) flow mu_A = c exactly and the bound is attained. Proven: mu_A-c <= (alpha_G-c)/2. verify_fov.py ran 225 cases on 3 grids and every check holds (D1 PASS). D2 is FAIL under the rule frozen before the run: rho_F/rho_G is 0.644-0.997 except in 9 upwind Hadley cases at Peclet 30 (1.033-1.104). Kill does not apply, because all 225 cases are strictly tighter in rho or alpha. verify_foundation.py and verify_run.py pass. THEORY.md §10 is appended.

build.verdict: Acceptance met: a stated bound, proven and checked on 3 grids (D1 PASS). D2 FAIL under the frozen rule: the FoV stiffness radius is looser than Gershgorin in 9/225 strongly divergent upwind cases. Kill does not apply: the abscissa is never looser (proven), strictly tighter for every divergent flow, and the radius is tighter in 216/225 cases. So the fallback (keep the separable route diffusion-only) is not forced by this node. The code nevertheless stays diffusion-only until a complex-block solver exists (P).
open_issues: rho_F <= rho_G does not hold in general: it fails in 9 measured upwind Hadley cases at Peclet 30. There, Gershgorin stays the tighter spectral radius; only the field of values bounds norms (Crouzeix-Palencia).
Not implemented (P): certified Sturm bisection for the support values h_m(phi_k), and a separable solver with complex mode blocks, the half spectrum and the Hermitian-part certificate.
The DOPRI5 explicit step bound from the FoV enclosure (a two-dimensional fit into the stability region) is P for KS-N5 and UNVERIFIED.
Checked only on 3 small grids (6x10, 9x16, 11x15). Longitude-dependent velocity, which breaks Z_np, remains O.

For divergent flow the certificate is conservative: the true ||W^-1||_A is 3.0-851x below the bound near threshold, and mu_A exceeds the spectral abscissa by up to 45. For monotone schemes the area-weighted L1 log norm (= c) is sharper in its own norm.
The task text says numpy 2.4.2, but numpy 1.26.4 is what is installed (recorded in ks_n8/NOTES.txt).
RUN.json and PLAN.json were not edited (the orchestrator appends). Claim K15 (O) can move to D/T, with D2 FAIL recorded.
The branch is not pushed, per the rules.

rulings: Norm: the area-weighted inner product <.,.>_A is primary (diffusion is self-adjoint in it, so the certificate reduces to §4.2). The Euclidean mu_2 of the task text is also proven and checked, but it is weaker for zero velocity.
Scheme: centred flux form is primary (undamped non-normality; its A-Hermitian part is the diffusion). Upwind is covered as centred plus negative semidefinite artificial diffusion.
Gershgorin reference for D2: row discs of the mode blocks B_m, i.e. the §5.2 construction applied to the advective blocks. Grid-space and weighted-column variants are reported as diagnostics only.
Amendments made before any run: K = 256 polygon directions instead of 64; the exit code covers the validity checks (A, B, C1); the D2 verdict is reported in the JSON.
Wall time was removed from KS_N8_FOV.json after the first official run, so reruns reproduce the file byte for byte. The numbers are unchanged.
A smoke run went to the scratchpad before the official run. Its numbers are identical (deterministic seeds); this is recorded in NOTES.txt.
